newsitem.title: USA: Amsouth deposit insurance costs cut.
newsitem.headline: Amsouth deposit insurance costs cut.

text.p: AmSouth Bancorp said on Tuesday that its costs for deposit insurance will be lowered by about $7.0 million a year.
Costs declined after an assessment from federal legislation of the Savings Association Insurance Fund (SAIF).
The federal legislation applied one-time assessments on the many banks nationwide that have deposits insured by the Savings Association Insurance Fund.

AmSouth affiliate banks hold approximately $4.6 billion of these deposits because many of the institutions acquired by AmSouth, particularly in Florida and Tennessee, were savings and loan institutions whose deposits were SAIF insured.
